data.title: 2026 Cross-Strait (Kunshan) Mid-Autumn Lantern Festival Opens
data.description: In Suzhou, China, on September 16, 2026, the 2026 Cross-Strait (Kunshan) Mid-Autumn Lantern Festival commenced in Kunshan, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province. The festival highlights two primary lantern exhibit locations at Huiju Square and Zhouzhuang.

data.title: Ex-banker in Hong Kong sentenced to 4 years for $1.6B false credit scheme, taking $470,000 in crypto bribes.
data.description: A former banking official has been sentenced to four years in prison for involvement in a scheme involving false letters of credit and accepting $470,000 in cryptocurrency bribes.

data.title: ETH predicted to hit $2,746, now at $2,626.56, up 5.49%. MACD stagnates, open interest down by 9.19%. Next 72 hours crucial.

data.title: Global Times: China's innovation success is real global news, landing in the living rooms of Italian retirees who barely use a smartphone: Italian scientist
data.description: On September 18, 2026, in Beijing, Moonshot AI, a Chinese AI start-up, unveiled its Kimi K3 large language model in anticipation of the 2026 World AI Conference and High-Level Meeting on Global AI Governance. This model is currently the largest open-source model based on parameters, exceeding any previous records. This announcement marks a significant milestone in the field of artificial intelligence.

data.title: MISSION SUCCESS: Rocket Lab Launches 96th Electron Mission
data.description: Rocket Lab Corporation, a prominent player in the launch services and space systems industry, has achieved a successful launch of the most recent Earth-observation satellite for synthetic aperture radar (SAR) company, Synspective. The event took place in Mahia, New Zealand on September 19, 2026. Rocket Lab Corporation, listed on Nasdaq as RKLB, continues to showcase its expertise in deploying satellites into space, contributing to technological advancements. This latest launch marks another milestone for both Rocket Lab Corporation and Synspective in advancing SAR technology for various applications.

data.title: PayPal Holdings Investigation Initiated: Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC Investigates the Officers and Directors of PayPal Holdings, Inc. - PYPL
data.description: A recent announcement made by Charles C. Foti, Jr., Esq., a former Attorney General of Louisiana and partner at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC revealed that their law firm has initiated an investigation into PayPal Holdings, Inc. The investigation focuses on scrutinizing the actions of PayPal in light of undisclosed circumstances. This inquiry comes in response to growing concerns and is intended to bring more clarity to the situation. Further updates regarding this investigation will be made available as it progresses.

data.title: Paramount considering concessions in merger deal with Warner Bros., including protecting CNN's independence and divesting Comedy Central. Lawsuit with 12 states could be settled.
data.description: Paramount is in talks with 12 states to resolve a lawsuit, with plans to safeguard CNN's editorial autonomy and sell off Comedy Central.

data.title: Corgi Insurance Appoints Daniel Hausman as Vice President of Trucking Program
data.description: In Atlanta on September 18, 2026, Corgi Insurance, an insurance carrier utilizing artificial intelligence, appointed Daniel Hausman as Vice President of its Trucking Program. Hausman, with extensive experience in commercial trucking insurance, underwriting, and program development, will lead the trucking division. This move signifies Corgi Insurance's commitment to enhancing its services in the trucking sector.

data.title: REPL Stockholders with Significant Losses Should Contact Robbins LLP Before the Pending October 5, 2026 Lead Plaintiff Deadline for Information About Recovering Their Losses
data.description: On September 18, 2026, in San Diego, a shareholder rights law firm named Robbins LLP issued a reminder to investors about a class action lawsuit filed for individuals and entities who bought or acquired Replimune Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: REPL) securities from October 20, 2025 to April of an undisclosed year. The mentioned class action lawsuit addresses potential damages caused during this period and is open to all affected parties within the specified timeframe.

data.title: FortuneX Acquisition Corporation and WT Realty Group Inc. Announce Business Combination Agreement
data.description: FortuneX Acquisition Corporation (NASDAQ: FXAC) disclosed their agreement with WT Realty Group Inc., a real estate platform that offers various services including real estate brokerage, escrow, lending, title, and technology solutions.
